 Pellegrino (DAZN): “We're united, Vanoli lifts us, we must fight every day” 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article After the Serie A Matchday 10 clash between Sassuolo and Fiorentina, Mateo Pellegrino spoke to DAZN. The Viola player was one of the key performers, scoring the goal that made it 1-1. 
 Pellegrino's comments to DAZN (via onefootball.com) fiorentinauno.com
 OneFootball Videos
 Pellegrino's comments to DAZN after Sassuolo vs Fiorentina
 Against a struggling Sassuolo side, Vanoli's Fiorentina were chasing three points, having last won on September 11 (a 4-2 victory at the Penzo featuring a Mastantuono hat-trick). After the match, Fiorentina player Mateo Pellegrino stopped to speak to DAZN about the game:
 Njie is helping us so much, not just with goals and assists, but also by taking on his marker: he gives us that one-on-one threat on both flanks. It's not just him, but Gnonto too. Honestly, I'm happy. The team had deserved this win for a long time, and I'm glad we're taking the three points home today. When things aren't going well or aren't going the way you want, all you can do is work hard, fight every day and give everything to try to turn things around. Today's goal was something of a reflection of that, but it's also a trademark of mine: it reflects my style of play, and I always try to do that to help my teammates. Coach Vanoli gives us so much because he's like another member of the squad. That's exactly how he makes you feel. He pushes you to improve every day and helps you understand what it means to play for Fiorentina.
